header: How a submission becomes a published paper

items.content: Intake. Compass checks the manuscript against the reproducibility checklist, assigns a handling editor and confirms receipt within one working day. Nothing waits in a shared mailbox.
Review. Two referees from the roster of 210 read in parallel. The median time to a first decision is 21 days, and a third referee joins only when the two disagree on substance.
Production. Accepted papers receive a DOI within 48 hours, a copy-edit pass and a proof the authors sign off. Print follows the quarterly cycle; the archive goes live the same day.
